evals.prompt: Use $prototype. I need a text-only prototype plan for a Jobmark feature that lets a user filter jobs by location and employment type. Keep it a thin vertical slice: state the user flow, minimal data/model assumptions, explicit out-of-scope items, and the fastest way to validate the interaction before productionizing it. Do not edit or deploy anything.
evals.expected_output: A bounded prototype plan with a thin vertical slice, explicit assumptions and out-of-scope work, and a validation loop.
expectations: The response describes a concrete end-to-end user flow for applying the filters.
The response distinguishes minimal prototype scope from out-of-scope production features.
The response states assumptions about data or the filter model.
The response includes a quick validation method before productionizing.
